crossRefs.note: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped…
They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob…
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath…
They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this…
They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
translations.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
translations.asv: And they gave unto them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,
